summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the required firmware version for sensors in Lithuania. Someone requested confirmation on whether the current firmware included a fix for duplicated device IDs across different vendors, as duplicates were being observed.

[p2] stated that the current firmware for Lithuania is 52.1.
decisions: The current firmware for Lithuania is confirmed to be version 52.1.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm if firmware 52.1 includes the fix for duplicated device IDs.
